source_language_scope: Supplied English records only; no new Greek, Hebrew or critical-apparatus verification.
numbering: Exact original nested chapter/verse order, references and anchors retained. The actual inventory contains 924 units in 16 chapters; continuation units and numeric gaps are recorded in inventory.json.
method: Complete actual source and retained target passages with necessary context were read and every retained explanation separately reread in the recorded batches. Unsupported source units remain pending with zero completion credit. Earlier completed objects and all unresolved evidence are preserved. Inventory alone earns no review credit. No exhaustive discovery or independent specialist verification is claimed.
completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
